description: Accedo helps the world’s leading content providers, television operators, broadcasters, and brands deliver multi-screen video services. They provide a combination of the products and services needed to support our customers at every stage of the video business journey, from strategy and conception through to delivery and post-launch optimization.

Adamant Quanta strives to innovate and deliver immediately useful cost- and energy-efficient quantum tech using defects in diamond crystals. Leveraging their extensive experience and know-how, their mission is to serve the timing, sensing, and detection markets with innovative functionalised diamond crystals that utilize their quantum mechanical properties to deliver superior functionality and performance.

Airsonett’s cutting-edge technology offers effective treatment of allergic diseases such as asthma and atopic dermatitis. The medical device provides ultra-clean air for the breathing area as the patient sleeps and removes the allergic load during the hours when it is often the most harmful, allowing the immune system to strengthen and recover.
tagline: A new standard for allergy treatment

description: AlixLabs is disrupting the semiconductor landscape with their innovative approach to manufacturing. Through their ALE Pitch Splitting technology (APS), they enable the precise division of nanostructures while significantly reducing energy consumption and emissions.
AMRA Medical offer MRI body composition analytics and deep expertise in disease research to deliver precise biomarkers.

Heart failure is the leading cause of hospitalization and death globally. AnaCardio is a biotech company in the clinical stage that is developing a small molecule pharmaceutical with a novel potential first-in-class treatment option. Based on world-leading research from Karolinska Institutet leading to the discovery of a disease-modifying mechanism they provide a unique approach with the potential to save millions of lives.
tagline: Changing the course of heart failure

description: Apica delivers intelligent telemetry data management and observability through its unified platform, Ascent. Built on AI/ML workflows, AI agents, and powerful root cause analysis tools, Ascent greatly simplifies the complexity of handling telemetry data. The platform provides an integrated solution for data collection, telemetry pipeline management, storage, and comprehensive observability functions. Through a single pane of glass, organizations can efficiently collect, transform, route, store, observe, and analyze their data while maintaining complete cost control. This enables them to quickly identify and resolve performance issues before they impact end users.

Arcam was a pioneer within 3D printing for aerospace and medical applications. Their patented technology, the EBM process, utilizes a high-power electron beam that generates the energy needed for high melting capacities and high productivity. Arcam was acquired by GE Group for 6 billion SEK.
tagline: 3D printing for aerospace and medical applications

description: Arevo is an innovation and product company that develops highly efficient and environmentally friendly plant nutrition products.
tagline: Grow plants with zero nitrogen waste

description: What if you could reprogram a cancer cell into an immune one? It sounds like science fiction but through years of research, Asgard Therapeutics might have found the solution on how to do just this. The technology is focused on direct cell reprogramming to discover novel approaches for cancer immunotherapy.

Cloud computing revolutionized the IT industry and made things we only dreamt of before possible. Today it’s causing challenges such as the need to be run closer to users or data sources. Avassa has a solution for that and offers a Platform-as-a-Service software where the customer can create and manage “private edge clouds”.

Airborne bacteria is a great threat to patients undergoing surgery and surgical site infections can be deadly. Avidicare is pioneering this field and provides ultra-clean air in operating rooms through its innovative air ventilation system to prevent surgical site infections.
tagline: A new standard for surgical room ventilation

description: BioInvent is a clinical-stage biotech company that discovers and develops novel and first-in-class immuno-modulatory antibodies for cancer therapy, with currently four drug candidates in five ongoing clinical programs. Its F.I.R.S.T™ technology platform simultaneously identifies both targets and the antibodies that bind to them, generating many promising new drug candidates. In 2010, after a successful investment period from 1997 to 2010, Industrifonden exited its investment in BioInvent through a block sale on the stock exchange.
tagline: Translating cancer antibody biology into immuno-oncology therapies

description: Bonesupport develops and markets CERAMENT®, an innovative range of radiopaque injectable osteoconductive and drug-eluting bioceramic products that have a proven ability to heal defects by remodeling to host bone in six to twelve months. Their products are effective in treating patients with fractures and bone voids caused by trauma, infection, disease or related surgery.

BOOST Pharma is a clinical-stage company founded based on research from Karolinska Institutet, focusing on novel cell therapy treatments for osteogenesis imperfecta, OI. The company’s treatment has a unique potential position on the market, since it targets the underlying condition causing fractures and bone deformities, unlike any other product under development.
tagline: The first treatment for brittle bone disease

description: BrainZell is at the forefront of a medical revolution, replacing and reducing traditional animal testing with advanced human cell models. By leveraging cutting-edge neuro organoids, BrainZell is shaping a more sustainable and ethical future for medicine, particularly in the field of neurological disease research.

Calliditas addresses the need of people with rare conditions – starting with treatment for renal and hepatic diseases. Today, Calliditas is the leading pharmaceutical company for treating renal diseases and develops treatment for inflammatory kidney disease as well as for Berger’s disease – the most common form of chronic kidney inflammation. Industrifonden exited in 2024 when the company was acquired by Asahi Kasei for $1.1 billion.

Carmel Carmel Pharma is the manufacturer of the PhaSeal System, today’s only clinically proven closed-system drug transfer device for the safe handling of hazardous drugs. Supported by more than 15 years of experience focused solely on the development of PhaSeal, Carmel Pharma offers the highest level of trust, quality and confidence. In 2012, after a successful investment period from 2002 to 2012, Industrifonden exited its investment in Carmel Pharma as the company was acquired by Becton Dickinson.

Cascade Drives revolutionary technical solution enables energy savings of 60 percent for the global market for hydraulic-based systems. With its patented technology, Cascade Drives dramatically reduces energy consumption and environmental impact, while increasing productivity.

CellaVision is a global medical technology firm that provides automated systems for routine analysis of blood and other body fluids in health care services. The products replace manual laboratory work, and support effective workflows and skills development within and between hospitals. The company specializes in image analysis, artificial intelligence, and automated microscopy. Industrifonden exited in 2015, several years after the IPO.

Cellevate develops and markets products based on a proprietary nanofiber-based platform – the Cellevat3d™ – a game-changing, green and sustainable, deep-tech innovation for the biopharmaceutical industry.

Industrial IoT and edge computing are major contributors to the next industrial revolution. As the industry is migrating to the cloud, Crosser provides a low-code platform for this. By helping companies to monitor their data in real time, Crosser makes it easier for industrial companies to analyze, automate, and streamline their production. Crosser was aquired by AVEVA, part of Schneider Electric, in 2025.
tagline: Pioneering real-time data from IoT devices

description: DbVis was founded with the vision of creating a universal database tool for all databases. The company has created DbVisualizer – a database management tool that supports connecting to a wide range of data sources over a standardized protocol. Today, the company has a strong global position with over 20 000 customers in 129 countries.
tagline: The database tool for all databases

description: 80 percent of a company’s value resides in intangible assets, but the process of trademarking them has previously been lengthy and cumbersome. Now Digip has made the traditional intellectual property rights market completely digital.

Disruptive Pharma is a Swedish pharmaceutical technology company developing and commercializing Formulite®, a patented and clinically evaluated platform technology for oral drug formulation and drug product development. Formulite® is designed to stabilize drug compounds in an amorphous state, improving solubility and oral bioavailability and creating new opportunities to develop and optimize oral drug products. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market Stockholm.
tagline: Platform technology for oral drug formulation and development

description: Regulation tech pioneer DPOrganizersolves companies’ GDPR and CCPA compliance challenges with an end-to-end solution for privacy management. Their Saas tool helps businesses map, visualize, report on and manage their personal data processing. The company was acquired by DataGuard in 2024.

eBuilder provides an array of enterprise tech services in business process automation and cybersecurity. In cybersecurity, they are a managed security service provider (MSSP), providing detection and response solutions as well as testing and advisory solutions. eBuilder Security has 100+ customers within the private and public sectors.

Echandia has since 2018 developed cutting-edge battery systems for maritime transportation, shipping, and other heavy-duty applications where safety and resilience are critical. Today, Echandia partners with the world’s leading shipyards and system integrators to equip both newbuild and retrofit vessels with advanced battery solutions, enabling hybridization, full-electric propulsion, and improved energy efficiency for large electrifiction projects all over the world.

Elypta is a diagnostics firm pioneering metabolism-based liquid biopsies. Its technology allows for non-invasive, safe, and cost-effective tests needed for early cancer diagnoses and for patients’ continued monitoring. Starting with kidney cancer, Elypta’s technology is being developed to ultimately be validated across multiple cancers.
Enginio’s platform brings together consumer activations, campaigns, promotions and loyalty programs. It simplifies and streamlines how companies, agencies and retailers work directly with consumers.

By replacing traditional fossil-based manufacturing of chemicals with a cell-free technology platform, EnginZyme seeks to play a key role in solving one of the fundamental challenges of our time – how to produce better, greener, and cheaper products that we use every day. The cell-free biomanufacturing platform combines the breadth and power of biology and the efficiencies of the chemical industry.
tagline: Unlocking the power of enzymes in chemical manufacturing

description: Envirotainer is the world leader in air-transportation solutions for temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals. They contribute to a sustainable world by helping their customers enable global access to life-saving pharmaceuticals, through patient-safe, reliable, and efficient cold chain solutions. In 201 Envirotainer was acquired by AAC Capital Partners.

Evam is a Leading Global Supplier of Mission Critical Mobile Data Solutions for Police, Ambulance, Fire & Rescue, and other Public Safety Organizations. Evam was founded with an ambitious idea: to help save lives by giving emergency services better tools when every second matters. The solutions are designed cloud-native, free from legacy constraints and shaped around the real needs of operators and first responders. With functionality, user experience and real-world impact at the core.

As our society becomes more dependent on an uninterrupted power supply, Exeri plays an important role in enabling a sustainable and secure supply of electricity. Their smart grid system monitors the electricity grid and can locate possible problems in real time, while at the same time providing increased security along the power lines.

Fast Travel Games is a game developer and publisher, building world-class virtual reality games. Founded by game development veterans, the company is on a mission to change the way we play. They build games where players are free to explore their surroundings, experience-rich narratives, and interact with others in new and interesting ways.
Fibbl is the world’s first cost-effective end-to-end solution for 3D and AR focused visual marketing. Integrate 3D & AR into your e-commerce and marketing in minutes.

Connecting with other fish enthusiasts? There’s an app for that! Fishbrain is the world’s most popular app for connecting fishing enthusiasts. Fishing fans use the app to log and track their catches, share tips within the network and boast about ‘the one that got away’. By doing so Fishbrain provides fishers with the tools and skills needed to perform better.
tagline: The social network for fishing fans

description: Footway is building a data-driven ecosystem for modern e-commerce where our four business areas work together to create growth, efficiency and sustainable development.

Mass collaboration is needed to solve the complex challenges of additive manufacturing. Freemelt’s advanced 3D metal printers for metal together with its open-source platform accelerates this process, making it possible to develop new materials, shapes, and applications the industry has yet to see.

Data without context is meaningless – or even misleading. Funnel offers a solution for performance marketers to make sense of all data by providing fully automatic data imports from >500 data sources and turning it into “business-ready data”. The data and insights are presented in real-time, allowing for marketers to optimize their performance marketing.

Gårdsfisk (Scandinavian Aquasystems AB) has developed a vertically integrated recirculating aquaculture system that enables land-based fish farming with minimal environmental impact. By working with partner farmers, Gårdsfisk ensures that its high-quality fish, including catfish and trout, are farmed locally and sustainably, providing Swedish consumers with a responsible protein alternative.

Gesynta Pharma develops novel anti-inflammatory, pain-relieving pharmaceuticals. The company currently focuses on endometriosis – a painful, chronic, inflammatory and estrogen-dependent disease that causes great suffering to millions of women.
tagline: A new non-hormonal treatment for endometriosis

description: Hopsworks has set out to make machine learning easy for every company, providing tools for data scientists and engineers to manage features and develop and deploy models in production. The company has developed a platform for data-intensive artificial intelligence with the industry’s Python-centric enterprise feature store.

The majority of mitral valve disease patients are not able to undergo treatments involving open heart surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass. HVR Cardio provides a new treatment option that is safer, faster, and less traumatic cardiac intervention for mitral regurgitation patients worldwide – without compromising clinical efficacy
tagline: The future of mitral valve repair

description: Inriver’s software for product information management enables B2B and B2C organizations to bring compelling product stories to life for highly customized purchases, obtain actionable guidance on what influences buying decisions, and then quickly adapt to put insights into action. Industrifonden sold its entire holding in Inriver to Thomas H. Lee Partners, L.P. (THL), a premier US private equity firm investing in growth companies in 2022.
tagline: The digital front door of your business

description: KISAB is an innovative provider of silicon carbide substrates, striving to define the future of the semiconductor industry. The company has developed a new process for providing silicon carbide substrates at superior cost and quality. This enables the device manufacturers to further push the limits of performance in future power electronics.

Limina is modernizing investment management workflows for asset managers. The platform includes order management, portfolio management, risk management, and compliance and empowers its customers to make superior investment decisions while reducing complexity and operational risk.

Most fats on the market come with trade offs in functionality, consistency or sustainability. Melt&Marble was founded to change this. Melt&Marble designs next generation fats and lipids. Through precision fermentation and advanced lipid design, Melt&Marble create high performance ingredients that elevate sensory experience, functionality and sustainability.

Meninga transforms the way banks use transaction data with a framework for next-generation digital banking and is a global leader in white-label digital banking solutions – serving over 100M banking customers across 30 countries. They help banks use data to drive digital engagement, build customer loyalty and increase revenue.

Micvac is a food-tech company that brings smart technology to the world of fresh ready-to-eat foods. The company has created an innovative method for preparing and packaging food, minimizing pasteurization time while maximizing nutrition and flavor. Best of all, the long shelf life that prevents food waste throughout the value chain.

To protect infants from GBS-induced diseases – a maternal vaccine given to pregnant women is the only long-term viable option. Therefore, MinervaX is developing a maternal vaccine for Group B Streptococcus (GBS) – the leading cause of life-threatening infections in newborns.
tagline: Maternal vaccine against group B streptococci

description: Movimento is a company within the automotive industry originating from Gothenburg. Their vision is to help create the software-enabled car, the vehicle through which we are forging the integrated and increasingly autonomous driving experience. The company has completed millions of vehicle and module updates for some of the leading companies in the world. The company was sold to Delphi Automotive in 2017.
tagline: Enables the software-defined car and beyond

description: Since the company was launched, it has developed into a fast-growing platform that enables the unlimited distribution of stories and knowledge in various digital formats. For a fixed monthly fee, customers can get unlimited access to popular titles across all genres. Today, Nextory is launched in 10 markets and is one of the Nordic region’s largest subscription services for audio and e-books.

Nodica Group consists of four specialized companies: ScandiNova, Scanditronix, IECO and Microwave Amps. By pushing the boundaries of technology, all companies design and deliver advanced power systems for new findings and progress in areas such as radiotherapy, scientific research and various industrial processes. The portfolio includes world leading key sub-systems such as high-voltage pulse modulators, electromagnets, RF- and power amplifiers, and precision power supplies.

Fusion power has the potential to provide a limitless supply of emissions-free, reliable, safe, and affordable energy for all. Novatron Fusion aims to revolutionize the field of fusion energy production.
tagline: A unique fusion solution to power a sustainable planet

description: Nuevolution is a biotech company with the goal to deliver drugs of the future for the treatment of cancer and inflammatory diseases. Nuevolution has a patent-protected drug research platform to identify small-molecule drug candidates against cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was IPO:ed in Stockholm in 2015 and acquired by Amgen in 2019.

Severe COPD is managed in crisis. NuvoAir replaces that with continuous care: home monitoring, a dedicated clinical team, and same-day access when symptoms turn. Their unique approach leads to fewer hospitalisations and readmissions than patients receiving standard care.

Oatly is the original oat drink company and a company that is built on the idea of change and in the 1990s, they set out to create a plant-based drink that was in tune with the needs of both humans and the planet. Oatly’s patented method uses natural enzymes to transform fiber-rich oats into a nutritional liquid. At the US IPO in 2021, the company was valued at $10 billion.

Occtoo is an Experience Data Platform built to accelerate the way companies create relevant customer experiences everywhere. With Occtoo the user can easily unify all experience data (customer, product, transactional, behavioral, content, and more) and make it accessible in real time in any front-end of choice.
tagline: The missing piece in a digital experience stack

description: Oncopeptides is a biotech company focused on the development of targeted therapies for difficult-to-treat hematological cancers. The company is science-driven and committed to bringing innovation to patients with unmet needs and improving patient lives. Industrifonden exited in 2018 and 2024.

Open Payments provides the groundbreaking market infrastructure required for open banking. The company has sorted out how to implement Open Banking in businesses and connect multiple banks through one single unified API. This removes the complexity and frictions of many diverse integrations.
A value driven brand and advocate for healthy physical performance optimisation for everyone that aspires to be a high performer.

Pixelgen has developed Molecular Pixelation, a DNA-based visualization technology for analyzing cell surface proteins, to gain novel insights into cellular activity that will advance better medicines and diagnostics.

Purpose Pharma is a patient-centric European based pharmaceutical company focusing on the development and commercialization of novel rare disease and specialty care products in areas of high unmet medical need.

Qlik offers an Active Intelligence platform, delivering end-to-end, real-time data integration and analytics cloud solutions to close the gaps between data, insights, and action. By transforming data into Active Intelligence, businesses can drive better decisions, improve revenue and profitability, and optimize customer relationships. The investment in Qlik provided Industrifonden with a return of almost 40x the invested amount. in 2016 Thomas Bravo acquired Qlik for $3 billion.
tagline: Closing the gap between data and action

description: Marketing tech company Realforce leads the new wave of digitization in residential real estate. Their platform makes it easy for marketing professionals to automate and scale recurring marketing activities for brokers and sellers with unparalleled control and flexibility.
tagline: The marketing and sales operations platform for real estate

description: Retein adapts nature’s finest separation for use in the recovery of clean water from any accessible water mixture. The patented molecular separation technology was developed at Chalmers University of Technology with the purpose of accelerating the transition towards a resource-efficient and sustainable world from the bottom up.

Founded in 2023, Roots Bio is building an AI-powered molecular discovery platform that identifies and develops novel molecules for agriculture, food, and sustainability applications. By combining computational biology, machine learning, and experimental validation, the company is accelerating the discovery of breakthrough solutions while reducing development cost and time.

SaltX is on a mission to reshape heavy-emission industries by eliminating their dependency on fossil fuels. Our main focus is the quicklime and cement sectors, responsible for a staggering 8% of the world’s CO2 emissions. We’re driving innovation and scaling up electrification and carbon separation technologies with one clear goal: to catalyze a massive shift towards zero industrial emissions at a gigaton scale.

Scalado is a world leader in the mobile imaging industry, with a long history of developing innovative platform-independent imaging solutions. Based on Scalado’s unique Random Access JPEG and more than 50 patent and patent-pending technologies, these innovations are currently being used by the world’s leading global telecom and platform players.
tagline: One more reason to love your phone

description: SeaPattern is pioneering innovative turbine technology that enhances electricity generation in existing hydropower plants by between 7-10%, without requiring new large-scale infrastructure. The company offers a fully integrated solution that combines modular, floating turbines with AI-enabled software for dynamic turbine positioning and performance optimization. With thousands of hydropower plants across Europe, SeaPattern has substantial potential to contribute significantly to the energy transition.

Senseworks audit and analytics platform allows you and your colleagues to work more effectively together, find more insights in financial data and deliver more value to your customers, based on a common source of truth for business data.

ShardSecure is changing the nature of data security. Their patented Microshard technology cloud-enables data by distributing sensitive data for use in the multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environment, while at the same time reducing management complexity and improving business continuity.
tagline: Secure your data in the cloud

description: With Soundtrack Your Brand, you can find the perfect music for your business in the world’s largest commercial catalog with over 58 million songs – all legal to use for your business. The platform gives businesses the freedom to play the music they want and the tools to make it easy; music scheduling, AI, and an explicit-lyrics filter.

Soundtrap is a collaborative, cloud-based recording studio, on a mission to make music creation and storytelling simple and collaborative for everyone. With an easy-to-use creation platform, Soundtrap empowers creators to build original content using a combination of software instruments, real instruments, and audio recording.

Teitur Trophics is a biotech company dedicated to developing new treatments for patients suffering from neurodegenerative diseases. The company has developed a platform of first-in-class cyclic peptides with a novel mechanism that preserves neuronal function. The peptides have the potential to treat patients suffering from a broad range of neurodegenerative diseases.

Texray has developed the world’s first radiation protection textile to address the need for comfortable and safe personal protection equipment (PPE). The Texray material is currently used in products designed for healthcare professionals exposed to X-ray radiation during surgical interventions. The Texray material may also provide value for professionals in various industry sectors, including nuclear, aero, and space.

ToxoTech is a research development biopharmaceutical company that uses expert knowledge in structural biology to design and develop novel toxin-based biological products for the treatment of neuromuscular and neurological disorders.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Lund, Sweden, TrackPaw Scientific is on a mission to address one of the key reasons behind over 90% of failures in clinical development: subjective and inconsistent conclusions from animal-based preclinical studies. By combining machine learning and sensor technology to monitor animal behaviour and weight in real time, the company provides scientists with objective, high-resolution data across a wide range of disease areas. This leads to more robust study outcomes, improved animal welfare, and faster access to effective new medicines.

Treebula is a Swedish company, up until now known as Virkesbörsen, dedicated to unlocking the full potential of forests. With a vision to utilize the true and upgraded value of forests, Treebula aims to be the premier source of forestry information, providing services and a digital meeting place for forest owners, buyers, and other stakeholders. By offering comprehensive forest management solutions and facilitating informed decision-making, Treebula strives to drive sustainable practices, promote biodiversity, and contribute to a greener future.
tagline: Unlocking the full potential of forests

description: Identifying, matching, and enrolling the right candidates for clinical research programs is the number one challenge in the global clinical research industry. Trialbee combines advanced digital technology and life science to create a next-generation platform that simplifies the enrollment process for patients and supports the successful completion of clinical trials and access to medicine.
Tribune Therapeutics is a preclinical biopharmaceutical company building a promising pipeline of novel medicines to treat patients with a wide range of fibrotic diseases.
tagline: A new class of anti-fibrotic drugs

description: TrustTrace’s technology empowers brands and suppliers around the world to standardize how supply chain and material traceability data is captured, digitized, and shared. With all of the trusted supply chain traceability data stored on a single platform, brands get the right evidence in the right place to back-up product claims and meet regulatory compliance.

Valdyr (Telness Tech) is a next-generation cloud-based B2B telecom solution for companies looking to enhance innovation capacity while reducing cost and complexity. The product offering consists of an end-to-end Digital Telco on Demand and a White-label Private Branch Exchange (PBX). The company’s flexible and modular telco platform can be deployed and run on any of the major cloud solutions, as well as incumbent IT systems.

Vesiro delivers a high-performance plugin for Elasticsearch designed to cut infrastructure cost and energy use for large-scale search workloads. Powered by Vesiro’s search technology, the plugin significantly improves search performance, enabling companies to achieve the same (or better) search experience with fewer servers. This results in lower cloud spend, improved scalability, and reduced data-center energy consumption.
tagline: Better search experience with fewer servers

description: Viking Analytics is a company developing AI-based machine health monitoring technology. They are on a mission to enable every industrial service company like maintenance companies, OEMs, and system integrators to monitor more machines reliably and sustainability.

Yangi sprang to life fueled by a love for sustainability, relentless curiosity, and a mission to safeguard our planet. It all began with one bold question: What if packaging could move beyond causing harm – and instead contribute to smarter, more sustainable consumption? Enter Yangi Cellera – a leap forward toward a future where packaging works in harmony with both people and planet.

Zalvac AB is founded around the research of Birgitta Henriques Normark and Staffan Normark. Their research explores the role of membrane vesicles – small nanosized particles released by bacteria – in the immune response. ZalVac aims to create effective vaccines that can induce robust immunity against various strains of bacteria.
tagline: Novel vaccines against gram positive bacteria

description: Digitalization quickly accelerates energy consumption and maximizing performance per watt in servers and smart devices is critical to breaking the trend. ZeroPoint technology delivers up to 50% higher performance per watt by removing unnecessary information from microchips in data centers and smart devices.
tagline: Maximizing performance per watt in servers and smart devices

description: Zymego is a leading healthtech solution helping healthcare providers reduce wait times, fill empty appointments, reduce DNA’s and eliminate booking admin – all through intelligent automation.
